propositions: Repository-effective project LLM criteria are injected exactly once into round_a and never into round_b, whose membership remains controlled by bounded escalation/overlay selection.
Each project finding retains its logical criterion id in the project.* namespace throughout the four-pass gate.
Project code-review ids active in exactly one gate resolve and calibrate through the criteria eval arm; unknown and cross-gate-ambiguous ids are rejected before calibration.
Activated project criteria with missing or invalid prompt/eval specifications raise a located configuration error rather than silently falling back.
Documentation section adds four distinct subheadings (Round A/B fan-in, Effective routing in Pass 3, criteria eval resolution, Configuration error) to document the exact landed behavior.
